_help: EXAMPLE BRAND. Glazeberry Clay Club is invented: the studio, its numbers, its prices and its five supplier partners do not exist. It is here so every format renders on a fresh copy of the engine and so you can see a filled-in brand.json. Every field is explained in brands/_template/brand.json. Copy this folder (or run brand.py new) for a real brand; never ship these values.

brand.name: Glazeberry Clay Club
brand.written: Always 'Glazeberry Clay Club' in full on screen; 'the studio' in running copy. Never 'GCC'.
brand.what: A pottery studio with a free weekly email, Glaze Notes (one fix every Sunday), and a paid studio membership: three live workshops a week and supplier discounts.
brand.audience: Adults who took up pottery in the last two years and keep hitting the same problems at home: cracks, drooping walls, runny glaze.

claims._help: Invented for the example. A real brand writes the source and date for each.
claims.readers: 12,000 Glaze Notes readers. Source: invented for the example.
claims.members: 600 studio members. Source: invented for the example.
claims.price: $180 a year. Source: invented for the example.
claims.discounts: $420 of supplier discounts from 5 suppliers. Source: invented for the example.

never: Never promise a result ('perfect pots in a week').
Never show a real person's face: the example has no people on camera.
Never name a real clay, kiln or tool company. The five suppliers are invented.

people._help: Nobody appears. The byline is always the mark ('logo').

free.close: Glazeberry Clay Club. 12,000 readers. Free every Sunday.

paid.outro: The newsletter is free. The studio is one hundred and eighty dollars a year. The supplier discounts alone are worth more. You get live workshops every week, help with your first firing, and a shelf in the members' kiln.
paid.price: $180 a year. 'Forty-nine cents a day' may sit beside it.

offer.one_place: The offer lives in exactly one place. To change it, change it here and re-render.

what_works.hook: Name the problem the potter already has, as a statement: 'Your mugs keep cracking.'
what_works.shape: Problem, the one fix, then the studio.
what_works.headline: Literal: the workshop, the day, the price.

fonts._help: One typeface everywhere: Montserrat (SIL Open Font License), shipped in assets/fonts/.

end_card.paidFollowOn: Glaze Notes is free. The studio is

voice._help: The samples were read by the macOS built-in voice Samantha (`say -v Samantha -r 185`), which costs nothing and is fine for a sample, not for an ad. For real ads pick an engine in scripts/voice.py.

ledger.worth: The supplier discounts alone are worth more.
extras: A shelf in the members' kiln

copy.communityLine: Join the studio. 3 live {units} a week.

beginner: For anyone whose first mugs keep cracking in the kiln.
Every Sunday: one fix, shown step by step.

hooks.beginner: Your mugs keep cracking. It is not your hands.

paid.offer: Members get three live workshops a week and supplier discounts.
